description: 京橋駅周辺三次元点群データ(令和3年度、令和4年度取得データ_LAS) [roads, bridges and tunnels and railways and stations] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 建設局. 令和３年度（2021年度）、令和４年度（2022年度）に取得した京橋駅周辺の三次元点群データです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 建設局. It offers 14 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
